name: icons
title: Icons
description: 25 Aqua icons: things as 10.0–10.3 drew them (computer, home, mail, lock, a check box, a light bulb, an open box…) with a 1px hairline, and Olivia's own pictures for Preview, QuickTime, Music, Document, Trash, Folder, Heart and Star, loaded when first drawn; the same in every tone except Folder, Heart and Star. `lucideToPack` names the one to use for a lucide-react icon.

files.content:
/**
 * The Preview icon: Olivia's own artwork, a PNG with its shadow in it
 * (apps/web/public/icons/preview.png, 192×192), inlined so the icons
 * install as source alone — as near-lossless WebP, half the bytes (no
 * visible pixel moved by more than 1 of 255). The name is kept from when it
 * was the PNG, so an icons.tsx from an earlier release still finds it.
 */
export const PREVIEW_PNG = "data:image/webp;base64,"
